descriptions.description: The Permitting Innovation Center (PIC) NEPA Data & Technology Standard v1.2 — a structured schema for environmental-review data collected during reviews conducted under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), 42 U.S.C. §§ 4321 et seq. Defines 13 entity types (project, process_instance, document, comment, engagement, case_event, gis_data, gis_data_element, user_role, decision_element, process_model, process_decision_payload, legal_structure) and a uniform set of six provenance properties added in v1.2. Producers (federal / state / tribal agencies) and consumers (the public, oversight bodies, downstream applications) agree on the entity shape so that NEPA review records can be exchanged in a machine-readable, lossless form. v1.2 deliberately does not prescribe a wire format — sample payloads are published as JSON, YAML, OpenAPI, and SQL DDL. Top-level container keys use the misspelled pluralisation `processe_instances` to match the upstream source — preserved for lossless round-tripping.
